signals.title: Burkina Faso, Niger, Mali Resume Talks With Ecowas After Withdrawal From Regional Bloc

signals.title: Kwara - NSCDC Arrests Man Over Minor's Trafficking to Mali
signals.summary: [Daily Trust] The Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) has arrested a 22-year-old man for allegedly trafficking a 17-year-old girl from Kwara State to Mali after promising to secure her employment in Senegal.

signals.title: In Mali, From the Wagner Group to Africa Corps - Will Impunity Continue?
signals.summary: [AI London] When Africa Corps officially began operations in Mali in June 2025, few people held out hope that it would help alleviate the suffering of civilians in Mali, caused on the one hand by armed groups in Azawad and members from the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (GSIM), but also by the army and its auxiliaries from the Russian private military company known as Wagner.

signals.title: Nduhungirehe, Mali Foreign Minister Discuss Ties, Regional Security

signals.title: Giving a Dam - Cultivating Peace in Côte d'Ivoire
signals.summary: [UN News] Adam Ouattara and Makongo Traoré have four children and a home on the edge of Torla village in Côte d'Ivoire. He herds cattle. She grows vegetables on a small plot nearby. For years, the dry season pitted their two livelihoods against each other.
